subject: How to fix the dimensions of all shiny widgets ?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: How to fix the dimensions of all shiny widgets ?
parts:
Hello, 
When we modifiy the size of the browser window, then the size of some widgets changes, for instance the sidebar panel and the tables. Is there a way to fix all the dimensions of the widgets ? In order that nothing changes when someone changes the size of browser window, and only scrollbars appear ?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: How to fix the dimensions of all shiny widgets ?
parts:
This should cover most of what you are looking for (I think). Put these in a css file in www/ and then use includeCSS("www/style.css") in ui.R

This keep the sidebar panel and its components, at least in my app, the same size even on bigger screens. I don't actually use the .span8 control but it seems you were looking for that.

select { 
  max-width: 200px; 
}

input[type="number"] {
  max-width: 185px; 
}

.jslider { 
  max-width: 200px; 
}

.well { 
  padding: 12px; 
  margin-bottom: 5px; 
  max-width: 280px; 
}

.span4 { 
  max-width: 280px; 
}

.span8 {
  max-width: 500px; 
}
